{{< video videos/showcase_gallery.mp4 >}}

Ubiquitin turns through cartoon, ribbon and ball-and-stick, then plays a synthetic
     sine-wave motion built as an in-memory MDAnalysis trajectory. A second storyboard places
     three copies side by side, each spinning about its own centre.

     ProteinMotion's deformation and morph back to the original coordinates need
     `Morph To Attribute`.

After ProteinMotion's [`showcase.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/showcase.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/showcase.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/showcase.py"}
{{< include scripts/showcase.py >}}
```
